findings.why: E-004 (live test output from a separate Claude primary-driver session) is stronger evidence for the behaviors it demonstrates than E-003 (documentation prose) is for architectural claims. Flattening certainty obscures this distinction and makes the credibility assessment less useful.

findings.claim: No evidence entry carries `refutes_any: true` or a non-empty `refutes` list.
findings.why: A perfect review with zero refutations of any prior claim is unrealistic. Either no prior claims existed (in which case the review is a baseline, not a delta), or the review did not exercise a refutation search. Both are blind-spot risks.
